hash_policy: hash equality/difference is supporting evidence only; never sufficient proof of copy or rebuild

lab_rules.LAB-A: controlled build not_applicable; literal test ft-b4 is LAB-B-only
lab_rules.LAB-B: strict controlled build for both canonical C sources; PASS requires full output matrix + cleanup

policy: canonical source inputs from candidate (resolved from R blobs; actual source SHA-256 == expected)
compiler absolute path and version captured
each output requires exit_code==0 AND output_exists AND size>0 AND ELF magic AND ldd exit==0 AND required JACK dependency visible
after build: delete outputs, delete build dir, zero ignored build outputs, git status clean, zero untracked, cleanliness_after=PASS
